title: Crestline Fleet Account Mobile Service Terms and Fleet Road Hazard Plan
content:
Some Crestline Fleet Account programs can have on-site mobile tire service dispatched to the fleet's yard. The terms below are per program; fees are in USD.

| Program | Mobile service can be dispatched | Fee per on-site mobile service visit | Vehicles to be serviced on one visit for mobile service to be dispatched |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Fleet Starter | no | 0.00 | 0 |
| Crestline Fleet Business | no | 0.00 | 0 |
| Crestline Fleet Commercial | yes | 49.00 | 3 |
| Crestline Fleet National | yes | 0.00 | 2 |
| Crestline Fleet Enterprise | yes | 0.00 | 1 |
| Crestline Fleet Public Sector | yes | 49.00 | 3 |

A visit fee of 0.00 means no fee.

## Road hazard plan for fleet vehicles

On every program the road hazard plan that may be charged to the account is Crestline Road Hazard Commercial LT Protection.

## Reading the schedule

- Crestline Fleet Commercial and Crestline Fleet Public Sector charge a 49.00 visit fee and need 3 vehicles on the visit; Crestline Fleet National needs 2 and Crestline Fleet Enterprise 1, both with no visit fee.
- Crestline Fleet Starter and Crestline Fleet Business do not offer mobile service.
